name: Clean
typeSystem: Static, strong, Hindley-Milner-based inference extended with uniqueness types, which enforce single-threaded use and ensure unique access when destructive updates occur. This lets Clean model I/O and in-place update safely without requiring Haskell-style monads.
runtime: Compiled ahead-of-time to native code; the underlying evaluation model is graph rewriting, with lazy evaluation by default.

runtimes.name: Native (via ABC machine + native codegen)
runtimes.role: Compiles through Clean's ABC intermediate graph-rewriting machine down to native code.

compilers.name: Clean compiler (Radboud University)
compilers.role: The reference compiler, including the ABC machine backend.

concurrencyModel: Unique 'world' values model I/O and state sequencing. Parallel and Concurrent Clean provide separate graph-rewriting concurrency facilities; availability is implementation-dependent.

codeExample.caption: Recursive factorial
codeExample.source:
fact :: Int -> Int
fact 0 = 1
fact n = n * fact (n - 1)

Start = fact 10
